title: Diagnostic Physics Teacher-to-Safe-Student Features
mission: Use timestamp-blocked IGRA, finalized climate, marine and TC sources to discover mechanisms and train deployable proxy students from safe inputs.
steps: Define teacher states such as ridge height, low-level heat/moisture, marine temperature suppression, cloud/radiation and TC geometry.
Train cross-fitted student models using only safe inputs to predict each teacher state.
Evaluate student fidelity and incremental residual value separately.
Never include teacher values in production scoring.
Record exact teacher availability status and student feature lineage.
Reject students that only reproduce target outcomes indirectly or fail folds.
failure: Poor fidelity or no incremental lift: preserve negative result and reject
